title: Article URLs Break on Capitalized Titles
description:
`build_article_url(title)` in `article.py` should build a lowercase, hyphenated URL slug from an article title using `slugify()` from `text_utils.py`. Right now titles with uppercase letters produce inconsistent, mixed-case URLs. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Files**
`text_utils.py` — `slugify(text)` turns text into a URL-safe slug
`article.py` — builds the full article URL from a title

**Function signature**
`build_article_url(title: str) -> str`

**Example**
`build_article_url("Hello World")` -> `"/articles/hello-world"`.
